observatory.title: Observatory
observatory.description: Limit to one USGS volcano observatory by abbreviation, e.g. "avo" (Alaska), "hvo" (Hawaii), "cvo" (Cascades), "yvo" (Yellowstone), "nmi" (Northern Mariana Islands). Leave blank for all observatories.

minAlertLevel.title: Minimum alert level
minAlertLevel.description: USGS alert levels in order: NORMAL < ADVISORY < WATCH < WARNING. This actor only ever returns volcanoes above NORMAL; use this to further limit to WATCH or WARNING only.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of volcanoes to return.
